title: Vickers Wellington BJ879
memorial_details: description: MURSLEY PARISH COUNCIL/ IN MEMORY OF/ (Names)/ WHO LOST THEIR LIVES WHEN/ WELLINGTON B.J.879 OF 26 OTU/ CRASHED INTO THE WATER TOWER/ AT 00.15 HRS. 11TH APRIL 1943/ DEDICATED 8TH MAY 1995/ TO COMMEMORATE V.E.DAY/ 1945-1995/ DONATED BY ANGLIAN WATER SERVICES LTD
